messages:
elena: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands today — quick post-meeting recap, clarifications, and the short action list so we don't lose momentum. TL;DR: Dedicated GA target = end of Q2 (June 28), docs draft up, canary plan and autoscale validations in flight. Links at the bottom.

sam: Re Dedicated GA — is June 28 a hard date? we depend on infra autoscale tests to pass.

elena: Not ironclad; it's our public target. If autoscale/infra validation finds regressions we allow a 1–2 week slip. We'll communicate any slip ASAP. Owners for infra validation: @matt + @eng-sre.

matt: I'll own autoscale e2e. Plan: 3 burst tests across us-west/us-east/eu next week, report perf + error budgets. Assigning to @matt and looping @oliver for rollout ops.

jia: For rollout: PM plan is canary -> broaden -> GA. Canary cohorts: 100 orgs -> 1k requests -> full. I'll own canary criteria and evals, will push prompt suites to the eval dashboard.

oliver: I can run the rollout ops and coordinate product/SE. I'll create the routing-policy doc and include fallback behavior.

lina: Docs question — who reviews the Dedicated Quickstart? need a tech writer and SE reviewer.

doc-bot: Draft published: https://confluence.redwood/dedicated-quickstart-draft — please add inline comments. Target review complete by Friday.

sam: Also raising perf/regression asks: can we expose a baseline SLO histogram (tokens vs latency) so integrators can test against it?

elena: Yes — Console will include per-route p50/p95/p99 and token-cost breakdown. @eng-sre please add a public dashboard link to the GH issue.

matt: Quick action list (short):
1) Matt / Oliver: autoscale e2e tests and routing-policy doc (owners: matt, oliver) — due 2026-06-04.
2) Jia: canary plan + evals (owner: jia) — due 2026-06-02.
3) Lina / Docs: quickstart review (owners: lina, docs) — due 2026-05-31.
4) EngInfra / eng-sre: perf dashboard + baseline export into issue (owner: eng-sre) — due 2026-05-29.
5) Elena / Product: confirm GA comms and public FAQ (owner: elena) — due 2026-06-05.

jia: Note — include fallback policy in public comms: degrade to smaller model or regional fallback, and what guarantees we give users during capacity events.

elena: Good call. @matt please add a "Fallback and graceful degradation" section to the rollout doc and the FAQ.

oliver: Will add fallback section and PR the doc by EOD Thu.

sam: After doc PR merges I'll queue the infra tests.

lina: I'll review the quickstart tomorrow morning and leave comments on the confluence draft.

elena: Links and resources: deck + recording: https://drive.redwood/allhands/may-2026-deck, notes: https://confluence.redwood/allhands-may-2026-notes, dedicated quickstart draft: https://confluence.redwood/dedicated-quickstart-draft, eval dashboard: https://dash.redwood/evals/dedicated-canary.

elena: If I've missed people who should be on an action, ping me here and I'll update the list. Huge thanks to everyone for the questions in the live Q&A — they helped tighten the rollout plan. :raised_hands:
